label: kizuna_language_a_02
text: Did you come all the way here to the staff room\njust to see me?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_a_03
text: Hahaha! Seems I’ve finally made it into the hearts\nof my students! That makes me très happy![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_a_04
text: After all, like I said in class, communication is\nvery important![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_a_05
text: If there’s anything you’re confused about in class,\nor if you’re having trouble here at the academy...[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_a_06
text: you can always come here and tell me, ton ami\nSalvatore—your friend Salvatore, that is! Ouais![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: kizuna_language_a_system_01
text: You became slightly closer with Mr. Salvatore!
